correctness.rationale: For p>=5, 2<=ell<=p-2 and unit m mod p, bijectively change index to a circle interval of ell residues. Its lag correlation is max(ell-s,0)+max(ell-(p-s),0); subtract from ell to get exactly T=2 min(ell,p-ell,m,p-m). Only lags +/-m^{-1} maximize the nonzero correlation, yielding precisely phi(p)/2 necklaces modulo rotation (m and -m coincide). For odd prime p, balanced ell=(p+/-1)/2 gives injective T, while unbalanced ell has the claimed saturated fiber. Under independent phase resampling with known bit-flip epsilon, each noisy disagreement is Bernoulli with Q_r=2epsilon(1-epsilon)+2(1-2epsilon)^2 r/p. Hoeffding yields the upper error, and KL/Hellinger adjacent central hypotheses yield the lower, with epsilon=1/2 unidentifiable. The proof distinguishes independent phases from a continuous orbit.
